messages.subject: For Kelly O'Rourke | External affairs, sustainability and responsible-growth execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Macdonald,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Kelly O'Rourke, Chief Legal, External Affairs and Sustainability Officer.

South32's integrated External Affairs and Sustainability model closely reflects the work I currently lead from inside a major mining operation. As the company advances critical-minerals growth across the Americas, Australia and Southern Africa, the quality of government, community, regulatory and sustainability execution becomes increasingly central to long-term value.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage high-scrutiny issues through clear ownership, evidence, timelines and executive escalation across operations, environment, HSE, legal, HR, finance, procurement and technical teams.

I would value a conversation about where this operator-side experience might support South32's external-affairs, sustainability, social-performance or regional leadership priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that fit.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
